subject: Mutual action checklist & sequencing for MedCore engagement (MSA/DPA/order form dependencies)
messages:
From: Emily Porter <emily.porter@medcorehealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medcorehealth.com
Date: 2026-10-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP & close sequencing request for Redwood pilot

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the model rollback features. Procurement/legal at MedCore asked me to put together a formal mutual action plan so we can track dependencies and confirm a hard close date. High-level constraints from my side:

- Pilot evaluation (technical + clinical SME review) needs to finish by 10/21 so internal stakeholders can approve budget for Nov.
- Our legal team requires DPA + MSA redlines reviewed before we can sign the order form.
- Procurement wants to issue a PO within 10 business days after MSA signature (we’re aiming for 11/03).

Can Redwood share a MAP with milestone owners, document owners for SOC2/Security evidence, and a clear sequencing that shows which items must complete before the order form can be executed? If possible, please include an estimate of legal review time (in business days) for each contract artifact.

Emily
Emily Porter
Senior Procurement Manager | MedCore Health
emily.porter@medcorehealth.com

[Attachment: MedCore_POC_Scope.pdf (stub)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Emily Porter <emily.porter@medcorehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & close sequencing request for Redwood pilot

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear constraints. I’m attaching a working MAP (Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx) that maps milestones to owners and shows hard dependencies between evaluation activities and contracting steps. Quick summary of sequencing (we can refine in a 20m sync):

1) Evaluation sign-off (owner: MedCore clinical lead) — target 2026-10-21. This unlocks production data access for the pilot.
2) Security evidence and SOC2 artifacts (owner: Redwood security, contact: Mina Haddad) — deliver by 2026-10-22 to avoid delays in legal review.
3) Legal redline exchange (MSA/DPA) — target 10 business days for each round; initial redlines from MedCore due by 10/15; Redwood legal will turn around within 3–5 business days once we receive clear DPA scope.
4) Order form finalization and PO issuance — planned after signatures; target PO by 2026-11-03 as you flagged.

Notes:
- We recommend parallelizing the DPA review with the MSA (same owners: Redwood legal + Anderson & Lee on MedCore side) to save time.
- If MedCore can confirm data residency / processing location today, Mina will pre-populate the DPA appendix to speed review.

I’ve linked the HubSpot record and the MAP draft in the worksheet. Aditya — routing this to you for the order form/payment term questions; Rishi — can you coordinate with James on expected redline cadence? Mina — can you confirm the SOC2 bundle ETA?

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx (stub)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Emily Porter <emily.porter@medcorehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & close sequencing request for Redwood pilot

Emily / team — tagging onto Lauren’s plan with a couple of sales/ops items so the order form doesn’t become the blocker:

- Order form draft attached (OrderForm_Draft_MedCore.xlsx). Payment term options: Net 30 (standard), Net 45 (with 2% early-pay discount), or PO-triggered payment per milestone (requires invoice schedule). Which does procurement prefer?
- We can provide a soft quote for committed throughput to reflect in the order form while the MSA/DPA are in parallel — that way procurement can secure budget.
- If MedCore needs an SOW for the pilot scope (clinical validation sessions + integration support), we should draft that during the legal review window so it can be attached to the order form on signature day.

Lauren: attaching our current redlines on the MSA for context (MSA_Redwood_v2_redlines.pdf). Rishi — please confirm if any of these redlines affect the DPA scoping so we can pack related items together for MedCore counsel.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: James Anderson <james.anderson@andersonlee.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Porter <emily.porter@medcorehealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & close sequencing request for Redwood pilot

Lauren / Rishi — I’ve reviewed the MSA redlines Aditya provided and have a handful of clarifying questions that affect the DPA scope:

- Data residency: please confirm where Redwood will host MedCore production data for the pilot (region and whether any backup copies leave that region). If backups cross borders we will need additional SCC-equivalent protections.
- Subprocessor list: can Redwood provide the current list and the process for notifications of new subprocessors? Procurement needs this in writing to accept the DPA appendix.
- Incident SLA: the proposed incident response timelines are acceptable in principle, but MedCore requests an escalation path with named contacts for breach notifications.

If Redwood can provide the SOC2 bundle and a subprocessor list by EOD 2026-10-22, I can incorporate those into a consolidated DPA and aim to return redlines within 3 business days.

Best,
James Anderson
Partner | Anderson & Lee (outside counsel for MedCore)
james.anderson@andersonlee.com

Date: 2026-10-20T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & close sequencing request for Redwood pilot — final sequencing & next steps

Team — finalizing the MAP timeline below (this is what we’ll track in the shared worksheet):

- 2026-10-21: Evaluation sign-off (owner: MedCore clinical lead).
- 2026-10-22: Redwood security to deliver SOC2 bundle + subprocessor list and DPA appendix draft (owner: Mina Haddad).
- 2026-10-23 to 2026-10-27: Legal redline exchange window (MSA + DPA). Target MSA signature by 2026-10-27 if redlines are limited to operational items.
- 2026-10-28 to 2026-11-03: Order form finalization and PO issuance (target PO dated no later than 2026-11-03).

Dependencies & gating items (explicit):
- DPA appendix (data residency + subprocessors) must be provided before the consolidated DPA redline pass.
- If MedCore requests contract-level indemnity changes beyond our standard, signature may move to a longer cadence; we’ve flagged acceptable fallback language in the attached MSA redlines.

Immediate asks for MedCore team:
- Confirm the preferred payment term (Net 30 vs Net 45) by EOD 2026-10-21 so Aditya can bake into order form.
- Confirm data residency location to Mina by EOD 2026-10-20 (if already decided, please reply all).

If everyone is aligned I’ll create the HubSpot timeline entries and a shared calendar with checkpoint reminders. Suggest a 15m legal sync with James and Rishi on 2026-10-23 to resolve any final open items.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
